data.title: Crisis-Keyword Domain Registration Surge — Bulk NRD Detection within 72h Window
data.description: Detects bulk registration of crisis-themed domains (5+ in 72h) matching government subsidy, energy relief, and commodity investment keyword patterns on cheap gTLDs. CrimsonVector research identified 846 crisis-themed domains registered in a single peak week during the 2026 Iran War oil shock, with 48-72h lag between government program announcements and domain activation. This rule targets the P1 infrastructure build-out phase where early detection can disrupt campaigns before victim-facing deployment.
references: CrimsonVector, 2026 Iran War Oil Shock Domain Intelligence Report — 1,435 crisis-themed domains
Interisle Consulting Group, Phishing Landscape 2025 — Bulk registration patterns on cheap gTLDs
falsepositives: Legitimate government agencies registering official program domains
News media or advocacy organizations registering crisis-related domains
Energy companies registering product-related domains during price events
